completion:
Using the test method standard (the spec), document what was done and the results.
3. Decide what went wrong.
4. Consult with your product manager to formulate the action to be taken.
5. Put the information about every failure in your project knowledge management document.
6. Create a consumer report of what happened and what the retailer/distributor will be told.
7. Save your consumer report in the customer interaction folder of the project knowledge management document.
8. With your report in hand, consult the project leader about the next step.
9. Save the decision about what to do next in the project knowledge management document.
